products.title: BLUSH HOUR
products.subtitle: Italian Mandarin & Red Berries · White Gardenia & Frangipani · Brown Sugar Accord
products.description: Blush Hour captures that fleeting moment when everything feels softer, brighter and impossibly beautiful. It begins with a sparkling, fruity freshness before revealing a lush floral heart that feels graceful and effortlessly feminine. As it settles, a warm sweetness appears beneath the florals, creating a soft yet addictive trail that stays memorable without becoming overpowering. It is elegant, youthful and radiant—the kind of fragrance that doesn't demand attention, but naturally receives it.
products.scentFamily: Sparkling Fruity Floral & Warm Brown Sugar
products.usageRitual: Spray 2-3 times on pulse points (wrists, collarbone, behind ears) immediately after a warm shower for all-day radiant projection.
products.shortDescription: Italian Mandarin, Red Berries, Blossom Accord. White Gardenia, Jasmine Absolute, Frangipani Flower. Patchouli, Brown Sugar Accord

products.title: VANILLA COVENANT
products.subtitle: Creamy, Warm, Sweet Gourmand · Vanilla-Led Accord · Deep Personal Character
products.description: Vanilla Covenant is built around the feeling of something familiar, warm and deeply personal. Its creamy sweetness creates an immediate sense of comfort, while the smooth development of vanilla gives the fragrance an intimate, enveloping character. Rather than being an ordinary sweet fragrance, it carries a refined warmth that feels close to the skin and becomes more captivating with time. It is made for memories that are quiet, personal and impossible to replace.
products.scentFamily: Warm Creamy Gourmand Vanilla
products.usageRitual: Mist gently on neck, wrists, and clothing for an intimate, comforting warmth that unfolds gorgeously as body heat rises.
products.shortDescription: Creamy, Warm, Sweet, Gourmand. Vanilla-led creamy accord. Soft, Warm, Long-lasting Vanilla Character

products.title: PISTACHIO AFFAIR
products.subtitle: Pistachio, Rum & Indian Cardamom · Pear & Lily of the Valley · Whipped Cream & Sandalwood
products.description: Pistachio Affair is an unexpected meeting of creamy indulgence, fresh fruit and sophisticated warmth. The opening immediately creates intrigue with the distinctive combination of pistachio, rum and cardamom, while the heart introduces a playful freshness through pear, raspberry and lily of the valley. As it settles, whipped cream, sandalwood and cacao create a smooth, luxurious finish that feels delicious without becoming ordinary. It is playful, seductive and unmistakably distinctive.
products.scentFamily: Nutty Spiced Gourmand & Woody Cream
products.usageRitual: Spray along collarbones and pulse points. Distinctive opening evolves into rich whipped cream and sandalwood.
products.shortDescription: Pistachio, Rum, Indian Cardamom. Lily of the Valley, Pear, Raspberry. Whipped Cream, Australian Sandalwood, Cacao

products.title: THE ECLIPSE
products.subtitle: Clary Sage, Bergamot & Rosemary · Egyptian Jasmine & Marine · Amber, Ambergris & Minerals
products.description: The Eclipse is built around contrast—the meeting of crisp light, open air and mysterious depth. It begins with an aromatic freshness created by clary sage, Italian bergamot and Moroccan rosemary, then gradually reveals a fascinating heart where Egyptian jasmine meets marine freshness and earthy patchouli. The final stage becomes warmer and more mysterious through amber, ambergris and mineral facets, leaving an atmospheric trail that feels sophisticated and different from the ordinary. It is a fragrance for those who prefer to leave an impression rather than an explanation.
products.scentFamily: Aromatic Marine, Crisp Herbal & Mineral Amber
products.usageRitual: Spray 3-4 times along jawline, cuffs, and chest for commanding, atmospheric sillage that stays fresh all day.
products.shortDescription: Clary Sage, Italian Bergamot, Moroccan Rosemary. Egyptian Jasmine, Marine Notes, Patchouli. Amber, Ambergris, Mineral Notes

products.title: GOLDEN BAKERY
products.subtitle: Banana Leaves, Geranium & Caramel · Sugar & Rose · Musk, Vanilla & Cocoa Butter
products.description: Golden Bakery transforms the feeling of warmth and familiarity into a fragrance. Its opening creates an unusual contrast between fresh green banana leaf, geranium and caramel before moving into a softer heart of sugar, rose and vanilla. The dry-down becomes creamy and comforting with musk, vanilla and cocoa butter, leaving behind a smooth sweetness that feels nostalgic without becoming childish. It is the fragrance equivalent of returning to a place that instantly feels like home.
products.scentFamily: Nostalgic Green Gourmand & Creamy Cocoa
products.usageRitual: Mist over inner wrists and neck for an addictive, comforting hug in scent form.
products.shortDescription: Banana Leaves, Geranium, Caramel. Sugar, Rose, Vanilla. Musk, Vanilla, Cocoa Butter

products.title: AFTER MIDNIGHT
products.subtitle: Almond, Coffee & Citrus · Tuberose, Jasmine & Bulgarian Rose · Tonka Bean, Praline & Amber
products.description: After Midnight captures the transformation that happens when the world becomes quieter and confidence takes over. Its opening combines almond, coffee, bergamot and lemon to create a bright yet addictive first impression. A rich floral heart of tuberose, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, orris and Bulgarian rose follows, before revealing an exceptionally warm and indulgent foundation of tonka bean, cacao, vanilla, praline, woods, musk, amber and spice. Bold, sensual and unforgettable, it is designed for nights that are never meant to feel ordinary.
products.scentFamily: Sensual Oriental Gourmand, White Florals & Woods
products.usageRitual: Mist across pulse points and hair before an evening out. Projection intensifies with body warmth.
products.shortDescription: Almond, Coffee, Bergamot, Lemon. Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Orange Blossom, Orris, Bulgarian Rose. Tonka Bean, Cacao, Vanilla, Praline, Sandalwood, Musk, Amber, Cashmere Wood, Cinnamon, Patchouli, Cedar

products.title: ROSE MAUDITE
products.subtitle: Fresh Rose Petals & Cardamom · Rose Absolute & Jasmine · Warm Musk, Amber & Sandalwood
products.description: Rose Maudite is a celebration of rose through the atmosphere of a memorable gathering. It opens with fresh rose petals lifted by citrus, cardamom and pink pepper, creating a lively and softly spiced introduction. The heart becomes richer with rose absolute, geranium and jasmine, while warm musk, amber and creamy sandalwood create a graceful trail that lingers after the moment has passed. Elegant without being loud, Rose Maudite carries the warmth of conversations, celebrations and memories shared with people who matter.
products.scentFamily: Spiced Floral Rose & Warm Creamy Sandalwood
products.usageRitual: Spray on collarbone and wrists. The opening blooms gracefully into creamy sandalwood and warm amber.
products.shortDescription: Fresh Rose Petals, Citrus, Cardamom, Pink Pepper. Rose Absolute, Geranium, Jasmine. Warm Musk, Amber, Creamy Sandalwood

products.title: THE NINTH TIDE
products.subtitle: Pineapple Sorbet & Mandarin · Salty Lavender & Bay Leaf · Earthy Vetiver & Patchouli
products.description: The Ninth Tide is a fragrance built around movement, freshness and the instinct to go beyond what is familiar. It opens with the energetic combination of pineapple sorbet, mandarin and bay leaf, creating a crisp and invigorating first impression. Clary sage, geranium and salty lavender then bring an airy, almost oceanic freshness before vetiver and patchouli ground the fragrance with earthy depth. Clean, energetic and distinctive, The Ninth Tide feels like the moment you leave the shore behind and move toward something unknown.
products.scentFamily: Energetic Oceanic Fruit & Earthy Woods
products.usageRitual: Spray on neck, chest, and arms. Refreshing burst in tropical humidity that lingers with rich vetiver.
products.shortDescription: Pineapple Sorbet, Mandarin, Bay Leaf. Clary Sage, Geranium, Salty Lavender. Vetiver, Patchouli

products.title: OUD RÉGENCE
products.subtitle: Deep, Warm & Spiced Woody Oud · Noticeable Projection · 10-12h Alcohol-Free Attar
products.description: A deep, luxurious attar crafted for those who appreciate fragrance with presence, character and depth. Its opening feels warm and refined, gradually unfolding into a rich, velvety oud character with an earthy, subtly spicy warmth. As it settles on the skin, the fragrance becomes smoother and more intimate, leaving behind a dark, elegant trail that feels naturally luxurious rather than overpowering. Designed to develop with your skin, Oud Régence reveals different facets throughout the day — warm in the beginning, richer through the heart, and deeply smooth in the drydown.
products.scentFamily: Deep Warm Woody & Spiced Oud Resins
products.usageRitual: Touch the glass dip-stick to pulse points (inner wrists, neck, behind ears). Gently press—do not rub—for intimate 10-12 hour luxury performance.
products.shortDescription: Deep • Warm • Woody • Spiced • Smooth • Projection: Noticeable and sophisticated without being harsh • Longevity: Long-lasting, designed to remain perceptible for 10-12 hours

products.title: Bulgarian Rose Attar
products.subtitle: Fresh Petals & Green Accords · Bulgarian Rose & Honey · White Musk & Creamy Sandalwood
products.description: Fragrance & Smell: A refined interpretation of the legendary Bulgarian rose, opening with the sensation of freshly gathered petals touched by morning dew. Its heart unfolds into a lush, velvety rose with a gentle honeyed sweetness, while soft musk and creamy sandalwood create a smooth, warm trail.
products.scentFamily: Dewy Fresh Petal Rose, Honey & Sandalwood
products.usageRitual: Apply with glass rod to collarbones and pulse points. The rose transforms gently on warm skin throughout the day.
products.shortDescription: Fresh rose petals, delicate green freshness. Heart: Bulgarian rose, soft honey, dewy florals. Base: White musk, creamy sandalwood, subtle amber

products.title: PRALIN DE MINUIT
products.subtitle: Roasted Praline, Almond & Caramel · Hazelnut Cream · Vanilla & Tonka Bean
products.description: Essence of the Fragrance: A dark, creamy gourmand created around the irresistible warmth of freshly roasted praline. It opens with a delicate toasted sweetness, gradually becoming richer and smoother as creamy nuances, warm amber and soft woods unfold on the skin. The finish is velvety, subtly musky and deeply addictive—like a luxurious confection enjoyed after midnight.
products.scentFamily: Dark Roasted Gourmand, Amber & Soft Woods
products.usageRitual: Dab lightly on wrists and behind ear lobes. Delivers an intoxicating gourmand aura that lasts past midnight.
products.shortDescription: ROASTED PRALINE, ALMOND, CARAMEL. HAZELNUT CREAM. VANILLA. TONKA BEAN

products.title: KHWAAB
products.subtitle: Fresh Citrus & Floral Dream · Turkish & Damask Rose · Warm Amber & Australian Sandalwood
products.description: KHWAAB is an enchanting fragrance that captures the feeling of stepping into a beautiful, unforgettable dream. Its essence is fresh, floral, warm and subtly mysterious, opening with a sparkling citrus touch and a soft fruity-green freshness before revealing a lush, elegant floral heart. The Turkish and Damask roses bring a rich, velvety beauty, while orange flower adds a delicate radiance and patchouli gives the composition a sophisticated depth. The smell of KHWAAB is smooth, romantic and refined—fresh at first, then increasingly floral, warm and sensual as it develops. In the dry-down, amber melts into creamy Australian sandalwood and dry Texas cedarwood, creating a soft woody trail that feels comforting yet luxurious. Its character is graceful, dreamy and quietly seductive: never too loud, but distinctive enough to leave a lasting impression. KHWAAB feels like a fragrance that stays close to the skin while leaving a beautiful memory behind—the scent of a dream you wish would never end.
products.scentFamily: Dreamy Fresh Floral & Warm Woody Amber
products.usageRitual: Dab onto pulse points. Experience the three-stage journey from fresh citrus dew to velvety Turkish rose and lingering Texas cedarwood.
products.shortDescription: Fresh • Floral • Dreamy • Warm • Woody • Sensual Character: Elegant • Romantic • Mysterious • Refined • Memorable Smell: Citrusy freshness → Velvety rose & floral richness → Warm amber, sandalwood & cedarwood

products.title: Whispered Surprises – Secret Message Candle
products.subtitle: Made with Soy Wax · A Hidden Surprise Inside · Floral & Fruity Aroma · Perfect for Gifting
products.description:
A little flame. A beautiful surprise.

Whispered Surprises is a unique candle created to make every moment feel special. Inspired by soft florals, sweet fruity notes and a warm, comforting atmosphere, this candle fills your space with a beautiful fragrance.

What makes it truly special is the hidden surprise experience—light it, enjoy the fragrance and discover the little message waiting for you.
ingredients: Carefully Selected Floral & Fruity Fragrance Blends
products.scentFamily: Floral & Fruity Aroma with Warm Comforting Ambience
products.usageRitual: Never leave a burning candle unattended. Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface. Trim the wick before each use. As the pure soy wax melts into a clear golden pool (approx. 60–90 min), the hidden secret love message slowly reveals itself.
products.concentration: 100% Golden Soy Wax with Wooden Wick
products.shortDescription: Made with Soy Wax. A Hidden Surprise Inside. Beautiful Floral & Fruity Aroma. Perfect for Gifting & Special Moments.

products.title: BIRTHDAY CANDLE
products.subtitle: Sweet Strawberry-Inspired Fragrance · Warm & Comforting Aroma · Handcrafted with Soy Wax
products.description:
Sweet, fruity and irresistibly comforting.

The beautiful strawberry-inspired design makes it a delightful addition to your space, while its sweet fragrance brings a cosy and refreshing touch to every moment.
products.scentFamily: Sweet Ripe Strawberry & Creamy Dessert
products.usageRitual: Trim wick to 1/4 inch before each light. Keep on a heat-resistant surface away from drafts. Allow wax to melt evenly to the edges to avoid tunneling.
products.concentration: 100% Pure Soy Wax with Organic Cotton Wick
products.shortDescription: Sweet Strawberry-Inspired Fragrance · Warm & Comforting Aroma · Handcrafted with Soy Wax

products.concentration: Handcrafted Wax with Delicate Floral Accents
products.shortDescription: Beautiful Handcrafted Design · Perfect for Gifting · A Charming Decorative Candle
